WOOCOMMERCE / ORIGINAL NATIVE CHECKOUT

Prepare your merchant connection.

Import the routes exported from your saved Woo products. Review their exact payment terms, then download the setup files for the original seller, buyer and delivery service.

woo-merchant0 PRODUCTS

Complete these items.

    Import your saved product routes.

    In a saved WooCommerce product, use Download saved merchant route in its Stellar Forge settings. Select up to 64 exports from the same shop and seller. Each checkout contains one mapped simple virtual product at quantity one.

    First installation? Prepare the original Woo plugin.

    Download the local preparation tool, select your complete Stellar Forge checkout or installed source package, and copy its original three PHP files into WordPress. Activate the plugin, save the product mapping, then import its route here. The included INSTALL.md covers those steps.

    The exported native amount is the merchant’s declared mapping. The storefront currency and total remain in WooCommerce and are frozen into each order’s private handoff. This page does not calculate an exchange rate.

    Routes stay in this page until you download a draft or packet. Import product exports here; keep customer order handoffs and private keys in the original buyer and merchant tools.

    Connect the existing shop and seller.

    Use the actual shop, facilitator and private service directory. The exported routes already declare the seller origin, methods, assets and recipients.

    A name for the downloaded ZIP and its editable files.

    The exact store that exported these product IDs. Use an origin without a path.

    For WordPress in a subdirectory, enter its actual same-origin REST URL. The settlement receiver uses the same REST base.

    Use the facilitator selected for the routes’ actual network. No credentials in this field.

    An absolute path on your Linux merchant host, outside public web files. Preparation creates this directory and refuses an existing one.

    Define the PHP constant SF98_WEBHOOK_SECRET in wp-config.php from the private key, and set the same value in the native seller and delivery-worker environments. The setup packet contains no key. The original PHP plugin requires WooCommerce, PHP 8.0+ and real MySQL/MariaDB named locks.

    Review the exact merchant setup.

    The route files retain their imported bytes. The local runner passes them through the original native compiler before creating the private merchant configuration.

    Run the original tools and release the order.

    The ZIP includes complete merchant and buyer instructions. Use the same private configuration, outbox and buyer ledger when restarting or recovering an order.

    LOCAL PREPARATION · NO STORE REQUEST OR PAYMENT FROM THIS PAGE

    One order, retained through delivery.

    Classic and Blocks checkout

    The original gateway creates an unpaid on-hold order and a private buyer handoff bound to its saved product, exact amount and attempt generation.

    Native buyer and settlement

    The original buyer reviews the live offer and retains its approval, signer, budget and ledger. The shop admits one verified native attempt for the current order.

    Merchant review and release

    The original delivery worker records its signed notice in WooCommerce. After independent reconciliation, the merchant releases the order through Woo’s own completion and download permissions.
